body.description: A draft's body, when its URL is too long to carry it.

id.description: The task's, routine's or artifact's id.

number.description: The task's or pull request's number, or the artifact's version.

status.description: The task's status as the tool left it.

url.description: The pull request, or GitHub's new-issue page prefilled with the draft.

fingerprint.description: The fingerprint the user compared with setup's output; only that pairing is approved.

agent_id.description: The Eta agent that publishes it, in its chat.

computer_name.description: The remote computer whose agent publishes it.

url.description: The public page's path on Eta's address.

preview_url.description: Its files for the browser to show in a sandbox, valid for an hour (PreviewTTL); index.html is the page.

after_run.description: Start once this run of the assignee's has delivered: current (its current or latest run) or a run id. Empty: now.

key.description: The request's idempotency key: sending it again is the same request.

loop.description: Make it a review loop: changes it asks for go to the assignee, whose next run it reviews again.

request.description: What the agent is to do; it is told this is the confirmed request.

config.description: What the user sets for it, a JSON Schema of string properties: environment variables of the agents that load it.

required.description: Built in and always loaded; cannot be disabled.

script.description: Run as root when an agent's image is built, from the bundle's directory.

values.description: By property: a value sets it, null clears it; properties left out stay.

script.description: Run as root when an agent's image is built; a shell script unless it starts with #!.

service.description: Its service; empty manifests remove it.

max_active_runs.description: How many runs the computer works on at once, its assignees' and assisting agents' on every runtime; more wait in the queue.

ready.description: Every required property has a value, so agents get the bundle's plugins.

set.description: Every property with a value, secrets included.

command.description: Run on the computer; works once, until enroll_expires_at.

max_rounds.description: Reviews at most, 3 by default; agents cannot ask for more than 3.
Reviews at most; the current budget when 0.

base.description: What the new branch starts from; the repository's current branch when empty. Paseo looks it up among the refs already in that computer's repository (the local branch, then origin/<base>) without fetching; origin/<base> names only the remote one.

branch.description: The new worktree's branch; eta/<number>-<title> when empty.

from.description: For a new worktree: Paseo's project id, or the Herdr workspace whose repository to branch off.

id.description: Paseo's project id, or the Herdr workspace whose repository it is.

older.description: Reads the entries before these (as before); absent at the start.

database.description: Give it a PostgreSQL database of its own (DATABASE_URL).

manifests.description: Its Kubernetes objects, as YAML documents: a Service named after the bundle (port named http) and what serves it.

protocol.description: What it speaks (name/major version), checked against its /.well-known/eta-service.

uses.description: What it may call through the runtime gateway with its token: llm, or other bundles by name.

state.description: applying (not ready yet), ready, incompatible (speaks another protocol) or error.

run_status.description: The assignee's latest run's status (assisting runs aside).

kind.description: created, comment, assist (body: the request; data: assist_id, agent {runtime, provider}, after_run_id, loop_id, max_rounds), review (a structured result; body: the feedback; data: verdict, assist_id, loop_id, round, head_sha), status, assignee, title, description, run_queued, run_started, run_completed, run_failed, run_cancelled, run_nudged, cleanup, deliverable or artifact (data: artifact_id, title, version).

reason.description: Why it waits, or is blocked or cancelled.

state.description: started: its run (run_id) has the rest.

run_status.description: The assignee's latest run's status (assisting runs aside).

assist.description: Another agent's assistance (请 Agent 协助), not the assignee's work.

queue_reason.description: Why a queued run waits: its task's previous run in the same lane, or its computer's limit on runs at once.

group_id.description: An existing group id, or an empty string to unlink.
